rag.content:
/-- See Note [custom simps projection] -/
def Simps.apply {R : Type u} {α : Type v} {β : Type w} [CommSemiring R]
    [Semiring α] [Semiring β] [Algebra R α] [Algebra R β] (f : α →ₐ[R] β) : α → β := f

rag.name: Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap
rag.content:
/-- When we have `[CommSemiring R]`, the function `C` is the same as `algebraMap R R[X]`.

(But note that `C` is defined when `R` is not necessarily commutative, in which case
`algebraMap` is not available.)
-/
theorem C_eq_algebraMap (r : R) : C r = algebraMap R R[X] r :=
  rfl

rag.name: Algebra.ofId
Algebra.comp_ofId
rag.content:
@[simp]
theorem comp_ofId (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) : φ.comp (Algebra.ofId R A) = Algebra.ofId R B := by ext

/-- The equivalence between `CrAnSection (φs ++ φs')` and
  `CrAnSection φs × CrAnSection φs` formed by `append`, `take`
  and `drop` and their interrelationship. -/
def appendEquiv {φs φs' : List ��.FieldOp} : CrAnSection (φs ++ φs') ≃
    CrAnSection φs × CrAnSection φs' where
  toFun ψs := (congr (List.take_left φs φs') (take φs.length ψs),
    congr (List.drop_left φs φs') (drop φs.length ψs))
  invFun ψsψs' := append ψsψs'.1 ψsψs'.2
  left_inv ψs := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  right_inv ψsψs' := by
    match ψsψs' with
    | (ψs, ψs') =>
    simp only [take_left, drop_left, Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine And.intro (Subtype.ext ?_) (Subtype.ext ?_)
    · simp
    · simp
